evidence: Affinity pulldown of mitoribosomal complexes from Diplonema papillatum, the diplonemid type species, demonstrates that they have a mass of > 5 MDa, contain as many as 130 integral proteins, and exhibit a protein-to-RNA ratio of 11:1.
The study focuses on the basic biology of the mitoribosome in Diplonema papillatum.

Four cell lines were generated each expressing a distinct PrA-tagged mtRP: mS49 (gene name MRPS49; gene identifier DIPPA_31280), mS63 (MRPS63; DIPPA_25715), mL46 (MRPL46; DIPPA_18631) or mL76 (MRPL76; DIPPA_24761).
